Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE detailed HIGH RESOLUTION DESKTOP RPG CHARACTER TRAINING SCREEN ART CONCEPT, not a working app, for a future desktop interpretation of the Allods Java ME fan reconstruction. Main visual lineage is PC "Allods: Seal of Mystery" (Rage of Mages), NOT a magnified phone menu.
Image1 original PC character screen; image2 original school: preserve jade/dark green carved stone panels with subtle gold dragon/vine corner ornaments, brown leather inset command buttons, thin burnished gold borders, readable warm pale-gold Cyrillic; a gray sculpted stone pillar bearing combat-school medallions; dark gray masonry behind. Image3 defines character likeness: selected Tagrim is FIRST portrait, mustached dark-haired middle-aged warrior, steel conical helmet and chain coif, leather straps, restrained red cloak. Image4 is proposed HD icon material vocabulary. Detailed hand-painted late1990s fantasy RPG art, sharp silhouettes, wear and brushwork, no pixel art, no modern minimal flat cards, no sci-fi, no modern MMO store.
Full-screen landscape preferably2560x1440, natural16:9 desktop composition, large legible text and controls; use all canvas, no phone frame, no external monitor/bezel. Header across top with "Персонаж", four small party portrait selectors, selected "Тагрим".
THREE substantial columns: LEFT about27% contains five attribute rows with labels/numbers and matching small minus/plus buttons; below, derived HP/MP/AP/defense compact summaries. CENTER about40% contains the original sculpted gray training pillar integrated into a skill selection panel, THREE big distinct gold medallions (sword, shield, tactical compass) and readable rows "Нападение", "Защита", "Тактика", rank values3/2/1 and small plus controls; a selected-school explanatory inset below. RIGHT about33% contains a large full-body painted warrior preview in an arch, grounded on stone, readable equipped sword and armor, with green HP and blue MP bars BELOW rather than covering face. The preview is concept illustration, not a sprite sheet.
EXACT visible attribute labels: "Сложение", "Интеллект", "Сила", "Ловкость", "Удача". Use values30,10,35,20,15 respectively as illustrative numbers, each row distinct, aligned. Five attributes are from MOBILE rules; do NOT replace with PC four-attribute Mind/Spirit system.
Header small summary "Уровень 5" and "Очки: 5". Resource numbers "633 / 657" and "6 / 6". Footer two clear large leather buttons "Применить" and "Отмена", short selected-school caption "Повышает силу удара". No shopping currency requirements on training screen, no premium currency, no consumables, no helmet/boots/ring equipment slots introduced as new mechanics. Panel spacing enough for desktop pointer navigation, original ornament concentrated around edges, not eating text area. All text Cyrillic, spell correctly, no lorem ipsum or English placeholder labels. No conceptual annotation arrows or watermark. This is a final-looking VISUAL PROPOSAL only; avoid copying red numbered annotations from references.
edit_prompt: Edit only the supplied character-training concept image. Preserve the complete layout, all panels, typography, character identity, item art, all numerical values and dimensions. Change ONLY the long RED health gauge under Tagrim's portrait at bottom-right to saturated EMERALD GREEN with a gentle dark-green fill gradient and bright green edge highlight. Preserve its gold border, white "633 / 657" text and the existing BLUE mana gauge below it. Do not recolor the small heart icons or any other red parts of clothing. No other design changes.
